people.name: Amminadib
people.line: Noble mentioned in a love song

translations.web: Without realizing it, my desire set me with my royal people’s chariots.
translations.bsb: Before I realized it, my desire had set me among the royal chariots of my people.
translations.kjv: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.
translations.asv: Before I was aware, my soul set me Among the chariots of my princely people.
